## Checklist

- [ ] I used the [standard project template](../templates/ai-project-template.md) for any new project entry, with every section filled in.
- [ ] New projects default to **🔵 Research** status unless a maintainer has confirmed otherwise.
- [ ] Any status change is backed by the required review(s) per [`/docs/governance.md`](../docs/governance.md), and the project's **Review History** table is updated.
- [ ] I have not claimed any project is "Approved," "Production," "SAMA compliant," or "secure" without documented review.
- [ ] I have not committed credentials, API keys, tokens, or sensitive WASL/customer data.
- [ ] Links in changed/added Markdown files resolve correctly.
- [ ] If I changed the website (`/site`), I checked it renders correctly and card data matches the corresponding project page.
